description: Source code for the AdvertiserFragment class in an Android Bluetooth LE advertising sample project. It manages UI interactions for starting/stopping Bluetooth advertising and handles advertising state updates and errors via broadcast receivers.
external_files: R (resources, e.g., strings and layout definitions)

classes.name: AdvertiserFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that allows the user to start and stop Bluetooth LE advertising, and handles related UI updates and error handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the broadcast receiver to listen for advertising failure events.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes the UI switch, and sets its click listener.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks advertising state, updates the UI toggle, and registers the failure receiver.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters the broadcast receiver to prevent leaks.

methods.name: getServiceIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to start/stop the AdvertiserService.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles toggle switch events to start or stop advertising.

methods.name: startAdvertising
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth advertising by starting the AdvertiserService.

methods.name: stopAdvertising
methods.description: Stops Bluetooth advertising by stopping the AdvertiserService.
